correctness.rationale: For D and D+cI, brackets differ by c(alpha y-beta x) lying in each subalgebra and in A+B, proving invariance. Inside the abelian ideal all vector subspaces qualify. Outside subalgebras have unique F_q(h+a)+W_j with W_j the only J-invariant j-space, q^(r-j) cosets. A mixed pair permutes iff U+W_j=W_ell; quotient graphs yield H_{r,j}. Two outside pairs permute iff b-a lies in W_{max(j,k)+1}; counting cosets gives the sum of (2t-1)q^(t+1), plus 2S-1 whole-algebra cases. The written count and leading Gaussian-binomial degrees give 0 for r=2,3; 1/4 for r=4; 1 for r>=5. Independent symbolic integer calculation reproduced all seven (r,q) totals in the source verification, including (r,q)=(4,2)->(N,P)=(98,6108). Finite-field samples are not asserted to prove arbitrary r,q.
